6.258 rsInvalidTablixHeaders
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidTablixHeaders is a critical error that will occur when, within a set of sibling TablixMember
elements, at least one TablixMember exists that does not have a TablixMember.TablixHeader
element present, and no sibling TablixMember elements or their descendant TablixMember
elements contain a TablixHeader.
